messages.subject: Google Code-In Mailing List
parts:
Dear all,


Dianne cook has set up a mailing list to discuss Google Code-In issues.
You can join the list from this web page:

http://groups.google.com/group/gci-r?hl=en

A wikipage has also been set up to collect ideas for tasks:

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gci2011&s=google%20code


If you are interested in participating in Google Code-In, please, join
the mailing list to discuss your ideas and keep the wiki updated. We are
still waiting to know whether the R Foundation will be accepted as a
participating institution but the list tasks will be taken into account
when considering our application.

Google Code-in is a Google's contest to introduce pre-university
students (age 13-18) to the many kinds of contributions that make open
source software development possible.

Best regards,
